theater: 斯泰勒利與阿爾及爾城牆

battle.name: 法國入侵阿爾及利亞
battle.theater: 斯泰勒利與阿爾及爾城牆
battle.brief: 一八三〇年六月十四日法軍在斯迪費魯什登陸，六月十九日與侯賽因德伊麾下大軍戰於斯泰勒利高原，七月四日攻下皇帝堡，五日在厄爾比亞爾迫降，九日入城。燧發長槍是法軍線列步兵的骨幹，射速與精度撐住整齊射擊，刺刀衝鋒與方陣才把三萬計的守軍打散。

kit.name: 燧發槍
kit.history: 擊錘打火比火繩穩。線性列陣的射速和精度都靠它撐著。

countries: 交戰的兩方是法蘭西王國與阿爾及爾攝政王國。進攻方屬查理十世王朝：一八二九年十月，國王與首相波利尼雅克在內閣與國會反覆辯論後拍板出兵，陸軍大臣路易·德·布爾蒙自任遠征軍總指揮，艦隊由海軍中將杜佩雷率領。遠征軍是自成體系的作戰集群，步兵以線列步兵團的分遣營為骨幹，包括第六、十五、二十八、二十九、三十七與四十九線列步兵團，另有輕步兵營，以及一八三〇年六月以當地人與法籍老兵組成的第一祖阿夫營；砲兵由德拉希特率領，工兵由瓦拉澤率領，並配通訊隊、海軍陸戰隊與攻城作業人員。依五月十一日的登船紀錄，全軍三萬七千人、四千匹馬，分乘六百七十五艘軍民用船艦；但五月末的狂風打散船隊，主力遲遲未能集中，灘頭作戰時可用兵力僅數千人。防守方是名義上隸屬奧斯曼帝國、實際由德伊自治的攝政王國：城防以耶尼切里與城市民兵為骨幹，外加奧蘭、康斯坦丁與提特里三位巴依的部隊，以及卡比爾山區部落的武裝，估計總數三萬至五萬，但侯賽因德伊只徵召了可用兵力的一半，統軍權交給伊布拉欣阿加。海權方面，攝政王國有規模不大的私掠船隊與海港砲台。外交上，奧斯曼帝國與英國敵視遠征但未出兵，西班牙、薩丁尼亞、俄羅斯、奧地利與美國派員隨軍觀察；突尼斯與阿萊維王朝拒絕援助德伊，只有的黎波里的卡拉曼里王朝響應聖戰號召。
countriesEn: The two sides at war were the Kingdom of France and the Regency of Algiers. The attacking side belonged to the regime of Charles X: in October 1829 the king and his prime minister, Polignac, after long debate in the cabinet and in parliament, decided upon the expedition, with the minister of war, Louis de Bourmont, taking command of the expeditionary corps himself, and the squadrons led by the vice-admiral Duperré. The expeditionary corps was a self-contained field force whose infantry rested on detachments of line regiments — the 6th, 15th, 28th, 29th, 37th and 49th of the Line — together with light infantry companies and a first zouave battalion of local men and French veterans raised in June 1830. The artillery was commanded by de La Hitte, the engineers by Valazé, and there were signal units, marines and working parties for the siege works. According to the embarkation record of 11 May, the army numbered 37,000 men and 4,000 horses, carried in 675 military and civilian vessels; but a gale at the end of May scattered the convoy, the bulk of the force could not concentrate, and only a few thousand men were actually available on the beach. The defending side was the Regency of Algiers, nominally subject to the Ottoman Empire but in practice autonomous under the Dey: its garrison rested on the janissaries and the city militia, reinforced by contingents from the beys of Oran, Constantine and Titteri and by armed bands from the Kabyle mountains. Their total was estimated at 30,000 to 50,000, but Hussein Dey called up only half of the men he could have raised and entrusted the command of the army to Agha Ibrahim. At sea the Regency had a small corsair fleet and batteries guarding the harbours. In diplomatic terms the Ottoman Empire and Britain watched the expedition with hostility but sent no troops, while Spain, Sardinia, Russia, Austria and the United States attached observers to the force; the Regency of Tunis and the Alaouite Sultanate refused to aid the Dey, and only the Karamanli Bey of Tripoli answered the call to holy war.
people: 決定這場戰役走向的，是一批後來極有名望的法國將領。總指揮路易·德·布爾蒙以陸軍大臣兼陸軍中將的身分率軍，他主持對阿爾及爾的海上封鎖多年，是最早主張用兵奪取城市的人；艦隊由海軍中將杜佩雷指揮，負責封鎖、登陸運輸與對城砲擊。灘頭作戰由洛弗爾多與巴泰茲內兩位師長分掌，旅級指揮官有達姆雷蒙、蒙克·迪澤爾與阿沙爾，砲兵由德拉希特率領，工兵由瓦拉澤率領，輕步兵分遣隊則由杜魯特率領，他本人已在登陸初期的接戰中受傷。值得注意的是遠征軍中同時湧現了一批後來法國陸軍的柱石：巴拉蓋·迪利耶、麥克馬洪、馬尼昂、佩利西耶與瓦揚五人在此時都只是中低級指揮官，日後全部晉升元帥；迪維維耶、拉莫里西耶與尚加尼耶則被稱為「非洲三將」，往後十餘年都在北非戰線。另一條線索埋在幕後：工程兵上尉布廷於一八〇八年奉拿破崙密令赴阿爾及爾偵察，六月的報告標出西迪費魯什為唯一可用的登陸點，並畫出經斯泰勒利、西迪哈萊夫與莫萊·哈桑堡迂迴阿爾及爾的路線，還建議出動三萬五千至四萬人，十五年後幾乎被布爾蒙照單全收。對面的關鍵人物是攝政王侯賽因德伊與軍隊統帥伊布拉欣阿加：德伊坐鎮卡斯巴遙控全軍，阿加則在前線調度三萬計的混合部隊。商人巴克里與布斯納赫、以及法國領事德瓦爾，都是把商務糾紛一步步變成兵禍的關鍵人物。
peopleEn: The course of the campaign was shaped by a group of French officers who would later become very famous. The commander-in-chief, Louis de Bourmont, led the army in his capacity as minister of war and lieutenant-general; he had run the maritime blockade of Algiers for years and was among the first to argue for taking the city by force. The squadrons were commanded by the vice-admiral Duperré, responsible for the blockade, the landing traffic and the bombardment of the city. On the beach the fighting was shared by two divisional commanders, Loverdo and Berthezène; brigades were led by Damrémont, Monck d'Uzer and Achard; the artillery by de La Hitte, the engineers by Valazé, and the light infantry detachments by Durutte, who had himself been wounded in the first days of the landing. It is worth noting that the expeditionary corps at the same time produced a set of the future pillars of the French army: Baraguey d'Hilliers, Mac Mahon, Magnan, Pélissier and Vaillant were all at that moment only junior or middling commanders and were all later made marshals; Duvivier, Lamoricière and Changarnier were known as the three great men of Africa and would spend the next decade and more on the North African front. A second thread lies in the background: the engineer captain Boutin went to Algiers in 1808 on a secret mission from Napoleon, and his report of June identified Sidi-Ferruch as the only usable landing place and drew a route around Algiers through Staouéli, Sidi Khalef and Bordj Moulay Hassan, and recommended a force of 35,000 to 40,000 men. Fifteen years later Bourmont very nearly carried it out word for word. The key figures opposite were the Dey Hussein Dey, who directed the war from the Kasbah, and Agha Ibrahim, who handled the mixed army of tens of thousands on the field. The merchants Bacri and Busnach and the French consul Deval were the men who turned a commercial quarrel step by step into a war.
kits: 全役的基本兵器是燧發槍。法軍線列步兵手上的是一八一六年夏爾萊維爾制式燧發步槍，口徑約十四點五公釐，彈重十四點六公釐，是法軍最後一款制式燧發步槍——直到一八三七年才全面換裝擊錘發。紙質定裝藥包把火藥與鉛彈合裝，射擊時撕開一角即可裝填，裝填速度比散裝火藥大幅提高；步兵通常攜帶六十至七十發，分裝在背包的彈匣與十二個三聯藥盒裡。火繩、鐵製瞄具與固定刺刀構成長身管的完整射擊循環，線性陣中以三排縱隊射擊與整排齊射交替維持火力密度，而在近身距離上能解決問題的是刺刀衝鋒而不是槍彈。一八三〇年六月十九日斯泰勒利之役，正是密集射擊加刺刀衝鋒扭轉了局面。英國方面的同類兵器是布倫·貝斯與一八〇七年後的新制式燧發步槍，卡面這件燧發槍即屬此列；英國皇家海軍自一八二四年起封鎖阿爾及爾港口，與遠征方處於對立面。攝政王國軍隊的槍械落後一代，以長火繩的穆謝特火繩槍為主，另有燧發手槍與耶尼切里短槍，斬首用的曲刀與卡比爾長矛並用；城牆與海港沿岸的火砲以青銅鑄造，數量以數十計。遠征軍的砲兵包括四、六、十二與十六磅野砲，以及從海軍艦上卸下上架的二十四磅砲，攻城階段另配重型攻城砲；六月十九日作戰時馬匹尚未卸船，火砲全靠人力抬上高原，這也是法軍推進緩慢的主因之一。
kitsEn: The basic weapon of the whole campaign was the flintlock musket. The French line infantry carried the model 1816 Charleville flintlock musket, of about 14.5 millimetres calibre with a 14.66 millimetre ball, the last flintlock pattern the French army would issue as standard — the conversion to percussion did not come until 1837. The paper cartridge combined the powder charge and the ball in one packet, so that a soldier only had to tear off a corner to load, and the rate of loading rose sharply over loose powder. An infantryman normally carried sixty to seventy rounds, divided between the reserve pouch on his pack and twelve boxes of three cartridges each. The flint, the iron sight and the fixed bayonet together completed the firing cycle of the long barrel, and in the linear formation the fire was kept dense by alternating the file fire of ranks with the volley of whole lines; at close quarters what settled the business was the bayonet, not the ball. The battle of Staouéli on 19 June 1830 was turned by exactly that combination of dense shooting and the bayonet charge. The British counterpart was the Brown Bess and, after 1807, the new pattern flintlock musket; the flintlock musket on the card belongs to that family, and the Royal Navy had been blockading the port of Algiers since 1824, placing itself on the opposing side of the farthing. The weapons of the Regency army were a generation behind, built mainly around long-barrelled matchlock muskets of the mouchete type, with flintlock pistols and janissary carbines, and with curved sabres for cutting and Kabyle spears for the mountain troops. The cannon on the walls and along the harbours were cast in bronze, and numbered in the tens. The French artillery included field guns of 4, 6, 12 and 16 pounds, 24-pounder naval guns landed from the ships of the line, and heavy siege guns for the siege of the fort; on 19 June, with no horses yet unloaded, the guns had to be dragged up the plateau by hand, which was one of the main reasons the French advance was slow.
tactics: 登陸本身就是一場沒有港口的強攻。一八三〇年六月十三日艦隊抵近西迪費魯什，十四日以小艇與沙灘作業分批卸下部隊、砲車與糧食，灘頭沒有像樣的港灣可供船隻直接靠泊。斯泰勒利之役最能看清法軍的戰術樣板：十九日凌晨四時許，守軍自高原沿霧氣湧下，耶尼切里與城市民兵在前，卡比爾游擊隊則隱入兩側灌木迂迴；法軍以旅縱隊接戰，砲火先發，達姆雷蒙與蒙克·迪澤爾兩旅正面硬撼康斯坦丁巴依方向來敵，十五線列團以刺刀反衝擊退對方，阿沙爾旅的二十九線列團增援接應，其三十七線列團在右翼與耶尼切里正面纏鬥，卡比爾游擊隊被第六與四十九線列團的推進趕出灌叢。法軍攻上高原後一度結成方陣，以防大批騎兵集結衝擊較弱的右翼，最後由德拉希特集中砲火驅散騎兵，守軍全線潰退，海軍艦砲也加入對潰兵的射擊；戰自凌晨四時打到午後一時，前後約八小時。六月二十四日在西迪哈萊夫再戰，七月一日與三日法國艦隊兩度轟擊城市，與岸防砲台互射但多數超出射程。攻取皇帝堡是另一套打法：六月二十九日法軍進抵堡下，三十日起掘壕，七月三日攻城砲全部就位，四日清晨四時全營同時開火，土軍反擊同樣猛烈、相持約四小時，至上午十時堡內火光熄滅、城垛盡毀而火砲多數被拆走或擊毀，守軍放火引爆火藥，主塔在轟擊中爆成碎片；堡門前依德伊懸賞徵首的指令堆起的首級，成為法軍進入卡斯巴前的最後一道障礙。
tacticsEn: The landing was in itself an assault without a harbour. On 13 June 1830 the squadron came in close to Sidi-Ferruch, and on the 14th the troops, the guns and the provisions were unloaded by boats and working parties along the beach, for there was no proper roadstead where the ships could lie alongside. The battle of Staouéli shows the French tactical pattern most clearly. Shortly after four in the morning on the 19th the defenders came down off the plateau through the mist, the janissaries and the city militia in front and the Kabyle skirmishers turning in through the scrub on either flank. The French met them in brigade columns with the artillery firing first; the brigades of Damrémont and Monck d'Uzer bore the brunt of the contingent from the bey of Constantine, the 15th of the Line answered with a bayonet charge, and the 29th of the Line was brought up in support, while the 37th of the Line fought the janissaries hand to hand on the right. The Kabyle skirmishers were driven out of the bushes by the advance of the 6th and 49th of the Line. Once on the plateau the French formed squares to meet the massed horsemen gathering against their weaker right, and de La Hitte's massed artillery finally scattered them, the defenders broke all along the line and the warships of the squadron added their fire to the rout. The fight ran from about four in the morning until one in the afternoon, some eight hours in all. There was a second engagement at Sidi Khalef on 24 June, and the French squadron bombarded the city on 1 and 3 July, exchanging fire with the coastal batteries, mostly from beyond their range. The taking of Fort l'Empereur was a different business again: on 29 June the French came in sight of the fort, trenches were dug from the 30th, the siege guns were all in place by 3 July, and at four in the morning of the 4th every battery opened fire at once. The Ottoman reply was just as violent, and for some four hours the two sides hammered at each other; by ten o'clock the fires inside the fort had died out, the merlons were destroyed and most of the guns had been carried off or dismounted, and the defenders, having fired their powder, blew up the main tower in the bombardment. The pyramid of severed heads raised before the gate on the dey's order of payment by the head was the last obstacle the French met before the Kasbah.
data: 可核對的數字集中在兵員與日期。出發前，法軍於五月五日在土倫與馬賽受國王弟安古萊姆公爵檢閱，五月十一日登船，總計三萬七千人、四千匹馬、軍民用船艦六百七十五艘，五月二十五日自土倫起航，二十七至二十八日遭遇狂風而船隊散亂，六月三日泊靠帕爾馬，十日再啟航，十三日抵近西迪費魯什。投入灘頭作戰的法軍遠少於此數，斯泰勒利一役實際可用者約六千至七千人；守軍方面，史料對總兵力的估計在三萬至五萬之間，而德伊僅徵召約半數，遠征軍內部流傳的敵情數字更被誇大到三萬五千至四萬。斯泰勒利的傷亡有較具體的記載：巴泰茲內師四十四人陣亡、三百三十四人受傷，洛弗爾多師十三人陣亡、一百二十九人受傷，合計約五百二十人；攝政軍方面的確切損失數字則無可靠記載，只留下大潰散與營盤被擄的描述，攻堡階段亦然。攻堡的時間表很清楚：四日四時開火，至十時堡內火力熄滅，前後約四小時，土軍反擊同樣持續約四小時，堡內城垛盡毀、火砲多數卸架逃脫，主塔在火藥爆炸中被摧毀。全役法軍的陣亡人數各方記載不一，僅斯泰勒利一役受傷者即已逾四百人。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked are concentrated in the numbers of men and in the dates. Before sailing the French troops were reviewed by the king's brother, the duke of Angoulême, at Toulon and at Marseille on 5 May; they embarked on the 11th, 37,000 men and 4,000 horses in 675 military and civilian vessels, and sailed from Toulon on 25 May. A gale on the 27th and 28th scattered the convoy, the fleet called at Palma on 3 June, sailed again on the 10th and came in close to Sidi-Ferruch on the 13th. The force actually put ashore was far smaller: at Staouéli some six to seven thousand men were available. On the defending side, estimates of the total run from 30,000 to 50,000, while the Dey called up only about half of them, and the intelligence reaching the French exaggerated the enemy to 35,000 or 40,000. The casualties at Staouéli are recorded with some precision: Berthezène's division lost 44 men killed and 334 wounded, Loverdo's division 13 killed and 129 wounded, about 520 men in all. No reliable figures survive for the losses of the Regency's army, which are described only as a general rout and the plunder of the camp, and the same is true of the siege of the fort. The timetable of the siege is clear: fire opened at four in the morning of the 4th and by ten o'clock the fires inside the fort had died out, some four hours in all, the Ottoman return fire lasting about as long; the merlons were destroyed, most of the guns were dismounted and carried off, and the main tower was destroyed by the explosion of the powder. Casualty figures for the French over the whole campaign differ from source to source; the wounded at Staouéli alone exceeded four hundred.
cause: 打起來的原因是一筆拖了三十年的商業舊帳。十八世紀末，阿爾及爾的兩位猶太商人巴克里與布斯納赫取得德伊信任，成為其財務顧問並壟斷對歐貿易；一七九五至一七九六年法國督政府作戰缺糧，兩人向法方供應穀物，價款卻始終未結清，王政復辟後只清償了一部分。此事拖累法國與攝政王國的關係近三十年：一八〇一年拿破崙與德伊穆斯塔法媾和，海盜也已式微，一八〇八年工程兵上尉布廷更奉密令赴阿爾及爾偵察，為日後的登陸做準備，但都沒有解決債務。一八二七年四月三十日，侯賽因德伊召來法國領事德瓦爾要求償清法國積欠的款項，領事在談判中受辱，即所謂「摑扇事件」；法國隨即斷絕外交關係，自六月十五日起對阿爾及爾實施海上封鎖，一封就是三年。期間一八二四年英國皇家海軍也加入封鎖，一八一六年英荷混合艦隊曾轟擊阿爾及爾。真正點火的是查理十世本人：他需要一場帶有愛國色彩的勝利來替日益脆弱的王朝挽回聲望，遂在一八二九年十月拍板出兵，而海軍大臣豪塞經營的封鎖與海軍的部署已把戰爭的技術前提準備妥當。
causeEn: The war came out of a commercial old debt that had dragged on for thirty years. At the end of the eighteenth century two Jewish merchants of Algiers, Bacri and Busnach, gained the confidence of the Dey, became his financial advisers and monopolised trade with Europe. Between 1795 and 1796 the French Directory was short of food for its armies, and the two men supplied grain, but the price was never settled, and under the Restoration only part of it was paid. The business poisoned relations between France and the Regency for nearly three decades. Napoleon made peace with the Dey Mustafa in 1801, piracy was already on the wane, and in 1808 the engineer captain Boutin was even sent secretly to Algiers to prepare the ground for a future landing — yet the debt was never cleared. On 30 April 1827 Hussein Dey summoned the French consul Deval and demanded settlement of what France owed; the consul was humiliated in the course of the interview, in what is remembered as the affair of the slap with the fan. France broke off diplomatic relations and began a maritime blockade of Algiers on 15 June, which was to run for three years. The Royal Navy added a blockade of its own in 1824, and an Anglo-Dutch squadron had already bombarded Algiers in 1816. The real match was struck by Charles X himself: he needed a victory with patriotic colouring to restore the credit of a monarchy that was growing more fragile every month, and in October 1829 he authorised the expedition, the naval minister Haussez and the blockade policy having already prepared its technical premises.
impact: 阿爾及爾陷落首先是攝政王國的終結。侯賽因德伊攜家眷出城，經英國軍艦護送安置於拿坡里，此後再未回國；攝政的名號在形式上殘存到一八三四年七月二十二日與八月十日的敕令確認吞併。軍隊方面，為應付山區游擊，商旅護衛與作戰單位大量改組，一八三二年三月成立的外國兵團便是為護送商隊而設；一八三〇年六月成立的祖阿夫營因熟諳地形、又與當地社群有血緣連結，日後成為法軍在北非的骨幹。但法國得到的並非太平：阿卜杜勒·卡迪爾於一八三二年起在阿特拉斯山區組織抵抗，一八三九年全面戰爭爆發，到一八四七年才告結束，一八四八年法國正式兼併全境，此後一百三十餘年間阿爾及利亞一直是法國海外領地的核心。對歐洲而言，這場戰爭改變了地中海南岸的權力分配：法國以一個小小的海軍基地取代了奧斯曼帝國在北非的代理人地位，並取得與英國在地中海對抗的支點。對王朝而言，這場勝仗只維持了三週——七月二日巴黎爆發革命，查理十世在位八個月後下台，遠征軍的捷報反而成了王朝的輓歌。至今阿爾及爾的街道仍留有以此次戰役命名的痕跡。
impactEn: The fall of Algiers was first of all the end of the Regency. Hussein Dey left the city with his household and was put under the protection of British warships and settled in Naples, never to return; the name of the Regency survived formally only until the ordinances of 22 July and 10 August 1834 confirmed the annexation. On the military side, the escort of caravans and the combat units were reorganised on a large scale to meet the mountain war, and the Foreign Legion founded in March 1832 was created precisely to protect convoys. The first zouave battalion, raised in June 1830, knew the ground and was bound by kinship to the local communities, and it became the backbone of the French army in North Africa. What France won, however, was not peace: Abd al-Qadir began organising resistance in the Atlas mountains from 1832, full-scale war broke out in 1839, and it did not end until 1847, with the annexation completed in 1848; for more than a hundred and thirty years afterwards Algeria remained the core of the French overseas empire. For Europe the war changed the balance of power on the southern shore of the Mediterranean: France replaced the Ottoman Empire's proxy on the African shore with a small naval base of its own and gained a point of leverage against Britain in the Mediterranean. For the dynasty the victory lasted three weeks — the revolution broke out in Paris on 2 July, Charles X fell after eight months on the throne, and the expedition's triumph turned instead into the dynasty's epitaph. Even today, streets in Algiers still carry the name of this campaign.
result: 結局是法軍以遠少於計畫的兵力完成了奪城。六月二十四日西迪哈萊夫再戰之後，守軍收縮入城與海灣砲台；七月一日與三日法國艦隊兩度轟擊城市，與岸防砲台互射多在射程之外；皇帝堡在四日被攻破並落入法軍手中，砲火居高臨下俯瞰卡斯巴與全城，攻守之勢已定。七月五日侯賽因德伊在厄爾比亞爾簽署阿爾及爾投降書，法軍在五日接收城防，於七月九日列隊入城，阿爾及爾陷落。以實際投入的六、七千名作戰兵力計，法軍在不到一個月內完成登陸、野戰、圍城與入城四個階段，擊潰號稱數萬的守軍，火砲的射程差與突擊速度是主要原因；阿爾及爾的城牆擋得住正面的強攻，卻擋不住由海上和南面高地上來的火砲。但這場勝利也留下清楚的代價：主力和攻城重砲遲到、馬匹未能上灘、糧秣自土倫沿海運來長逾兩千公里，攻下城市不等於控制郊區，一八三二年起法軍在阿爾及利亞又打了十七年山地戰爭，遠征軍留下的並不是一個安於現狀的屬地。
resultEn: The outcome was that the French took the city with far fewer men than had been planned. After the second engagement at Sidi Khalef on 24 June the defenders withdrew into the city and the batteries guarding the bay; the French squadron bombarded the city on 1 and 3 July and exchanged fire with the coastal batteries, mostly from beyond their range; and Fort l'Empereur was carried on the 4th, its guns commanding the Kasbah and the whole city from above, after which the balance of the siege was settled. On 5 July Hussein Dey signed the capitulation of Algiers at El Biar, the French took over the defences on the 5th, and on 9 July the columns entered the city and Algiers was taken. With some six or seven thousand men actually engaged, the French completed landing, field battle, siege and entry into the city in under a month and broke a defending army numbered in tens of thousands; the reach of the artillery and the speed of the attack were the main reasons. The walls of Algiers could hold against a frontal assault, but not against gunfire coming from the sea and from the heights to the south. The victory also left its bill clear: the main body and the heavy siege guns arrived late, the horses never got ashore, and the provisions travelled more than two thousand kilometres from Toulon along the coast. Taking the city was not the same as holding the countryside, and from 1832 the French fought another seventeen years of mountain war in Algeria. What the expedition left behind was not a province content to sit still.
